pro_course_detail.title: 7 Easy Ways to Improve Your Vocabulary Fast and Overcome the Struggle (A1 - C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
Words are the basic blocks of the language, and one of the key predictors of someone’s education level, profession, and social status. Yet most students struggle to increase their vocabulary effectively, as unfamiliar words go one into one ear and out the other.

It’s not that we have difficulties grasping the vocabulary when we see it. Rather, we struggle to recall when we use it, or worse yet, forget to use it frequently enough only to end up back where we began.

This lesson will describe seven proven tactics to overcome this struggle and learn new words faster, recall them more effectively, and remember them forever.

Students will be assigned light homework exercises to review vocabulary and structures covered in class before the next lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: Lesestunde: German Reading and Writing (B1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
In order to improve your reading and writing skills we will practise different reading techniques and strategies and look at writing as a process. During our German lessons we will read an interesting text - at times aloud, at times individually - before completing exercises that will help to strengthen your understanding of the text and expand your vocabulary. You will learn how to avoid writing mistakes and how to successfully structure and edit your own writing so that is easily readable. 
 
Our aim in this course is not to seek perfection or mistake-free German, but rather to strive towards an understandable use of the language in speech and writing and deepen your joy of reading.

Während der Deutschstunde lesen wir mal vor, mal als Einzelarbeit, und erledigen Aufgaben, die Ihr Verständnis des Textes verfestigen und ihren Wortschatz erweitern sollen. pro_course_detail.description:

We will practise reading aloud and individually during our English lessons, although at times you may be asked to read a chapter or medium-length short story at home to prepare for our discussion in the next lesson. We will look at different strategies for using a text to learn new vocabulary, complete comprehension exercises in order to strengthen your understanding of key ideas in the text, and learn to structure and edit your own stories, essays and written responses.
 
Our aim in this course is not to seek perfection or mistake-free English, but rather to strive towards an effective use of the language in speech and writing and deepen your joy of reading.

In this course we will read and discuss a handful of English-language texts that have served as the inspiration for art, poetry, drama, and film from their conception to the modern day. We will take a look at both historical and modern works, including plays, short stories, essays and longer works, some of which may be adapted for the modern reader. Although our discussions and activities will be loosely structured on key themes and elements of style in the texts, students are encouraged to bring their own discussion questions and ideas to class.

A modest, manageable amount of at-home reading may be assigned depending on the work we are covering. Students are advised to take their time with the material and wait to book the next lesson until they have completed the reading.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Speaking Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
In the IELTS speaking test you must have an 11-14 minute discussion with an examiner.

The test is given in 3 parts:

Part 1: yourself and your family

Part 2 & 3: random topic

In the lesson we will practice for part 1, 2, and 3. I will time you and give you corrections on your grammar, pronunciation, and vocabulary. I will help you give longer answers and express yourself with more fluency.

The scores are given from band 0 to band 9. Since I am not an examiner and don't work for the IELTS exams I can't give you a score for you to know your level but I can help you do your best at the level that you are at.

pro_course_detail.title: TOEFL Speaking Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
The TOEFL speaking section measures your ability to communicate in an academic setting, the 4 questions will resemble real life situations you may encounter inside and outside of school. 

The TOEFL is scored on a scale of 0 to 30.

I will give you some sample questions and will time you on your answers. I will correct any mistakes and give you suggestions to improve your answers. 

I am not an examiner and do not work for TOEFL so I cannot give you a score but I can help you do your best at the level that you are at.

pro_course_detail.title: Supremo Latin American Spanish
pro_course_detail.description:
This is a unique opportunity for you since I am American and English is my first language. My Spanish is near-native. That means that I'm not just fluent in Spanish, but quite often I am mistaken for a native speaker and because of how well I speak and interact in Spanish many natives are surprised that I'm American. 

Since there are so many native Spanish speakers on italki, why take classes with me?  Sooner or later there will be some expressions, concepts or ideas that you will not be able to either understand or express. A native Spanish speaker won't necessarily be able to explain this and help you to clear up your confusion on the subject the way I can. Sometimes a hundred examples just doesn't help you to know how to say something. As a speaker of English I usually anticipate what my students are trying to say. My classes are extremely productive. 

I have been a translator and interpreter for over 20 years. I've lived in Spain, Colombia, Peru, Chile, Costa Rica and Panama.  So not only do I speak Spanish almost like a native, but I'm familiar with some of the accents and vocabulary differences that you might come across from country to country. 

It's a great language. It's fun to learn, but it does take work.  Why not try some classes with me. I know you'll enjoy them.

I prefer to speak Spanish in the class. I will slow it down if you need that. I will make sure you understand me and slowly increase the speed over time as your comprehension increases. If you insist I will be happy to speak some English in the class to guide you and explain some grammar rules if need be. 

I am a certified TEFL and TESOL language instructor and I use similar methods when I teach Spanish. I look forward to hearing from you.
